CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

2. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 5
   C. 26
   D. 25

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 42
   C. 90
   D. 30

6. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

7. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

9. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

10. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 34
   C. 22
   D. 17

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

13. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

14. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 64
   C. 32
   D. 9

15. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

16. Solve for x: x + 7 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 5

17. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

18. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

19. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 42

20. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

21. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 19
   C. 17
   D. 7

22. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 49
   D. 14

23. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
